# ============================================================================
# PROVENANCE (Amethyst Task206 vendor)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# This tree is NG-GL4ES ("Krypton Wrapper") -- the gl4es fork used by
# ZalithLauncher 2 as its "ng gl4es" renderer:
#   upstream : https://github.com/BZLZHH/NG-GL4ES  (fork of ptitSeb/gl4es
#              + PojavLauncherTeam/gl4es-114-extra; MIT)
#   snapshot : codeload tarball refs/heads/main, fetched 2026-10-01
#   pruning  : 3rdparty/ (submodule stubs -- see adaptation 1), external/
#              (MetalANGLE .tbd stub -- see adaptation 2), traces/ (46MB of
#              apitrace dumps), spec/, refs/, media/, tests/, debian/,
#              GL4ES.cbp / test.cmake / gl4es.png / _config.yml.
#   kept     : src/ (unmodified), include/ (glslang/ headers REMOVED, see
#              adaptation 1), version.h, LICENSE, README*.md, COMPILE.md,
#              CHANGELOG.md, USAGE.md.
#
# Amethyst adaptations vs the upstream CMakeLists.txt (5):
#  1. No 3rdparty/ submodules. glslang is linked STATIC from the dep_mg build
#     tree (pinned f5f664d = 15.0.0 + the two in-repo crash patches:
#     lvalue-nullguard + pool-zero/size-guards -- inheriting the fixes for the
#     constArray/pool crash family that killed MC 26.x sessions). Because the
#     linked glslang is 15.0, NG's vendored include/glslang/ headers (15.4)
#     were REMOVED from this tree -- the compile uses
#     NGGL4ES_GLSLANG_INCLUDE (the pinned glslang submodule source dir) so
#     headers and static libs can never drift apart. SPIRV-Cross is linked
#     via the prebuilt impl dylib (NGGL4ES_SPVC_IMPL); NG's vendored
#     spirv_cross_c.h is byte-identical to the header that impl was built
#     against (MobileGlues-cpp/include copy, verified in Task206), so the C
#     API ABI matches exactly.
#     glsl_for_es.cpp uses only glslang APIs that are stable across 15.0
#     (TShader/TProgram/SpvOptions/GlslangToSpv/InitializeProcess -- audited
#     in Task206).
#  2. iOS frameworks: Amethyst's bundled ANGLE frameworks under
#     NGGL4ES_FRAMEWORK_DIR (libEGL.framework + libGLESv2.framework, the
#     same install names libgl4es_114 / vgpu already link). Upstream's
#     external/MetalANGLE.framework .tbd stub is not used.
#  3. NOX11 + NOEGL always defined (upstream only sets NOX11 for ANDROID).
#     NOEGL is the Task179 lesson: the temporary-EGL probe-context path is
#     dead on iOS in a late-loaded dylib (LOAD_EGL all NULL -> SIGSEGV);
#     with NOEGL the hardware probe runs on the CURRENT host context and
#     backend resolution goes through proc_address (host pins it via the
#     exported set_getprocaddress + ame204_gl4esProcResolver, Task204
#     pattern). DEFAULT_ES=3 and NO_GBM match upstream's C_FLAGS.
#  4. Apple-unsafe flags removed: -Wl,--strip-all and -Wl,--gc-sections are
#     GNU-ld only; LTO (check_ipo_supported) disabled; C++ standard lowered
#     23 -> 17 (nothing in the 3 .cpp files needs more; matches the house
#     glsl_optimizer target). Upstream's -O3/-g0 kept as -O2 for CI sanity.
#  7. src/gl/loader.h (Task206d, CI run 36806869734): LOAD_GLES3_OR_EXT is
#     only defined in the non-NOEGL branch upstream, but drawing.c and
#     framebuffers.c use it unguarded; the NOEGL branch now defines it
#     (proc_address on the host-provided current context, base name
#     first + EXT fallback, mirroring the non-NOEGL eglGetProcAddress
#     chain). directstate.c's two AliasDecl internal aliases are guarded
#     !__APPLE__ (same bare-attribute rejection; emitted by the
#     generator's raw-text AliasDecl pass instead).
#  6. src/gl/string_utils.c (Task206b, CI run 36805637724): the 18 bare
#     `RET NAME(ARGS) __attribute__((alias("gl4es_...")))` helper aliases for
#     vgpu/shaderconv.c are guarded behind #if !defined(__APPLE__) -- Apple
#     clang rejects the bare alias attribute on darwin (same reason
#     attributes.h retires AliasExport). The symbols are provided by the
#     generated nggl4es_darwin_aliases.c instead (the generator's raw-text
#     alias-attribute pass), so shaderconv.c's references still resolve.
#  5. src/gl/wrap/nggl4es_darwin_aliases.c (GENERATED by
#     scripts/task206_gen_nggl4es_aliases.py) is added to the source list:
#     upstream's attributes.h retires the whole AliasExport family to bare
#     prototypes on __APPLE__, so the plain gl* export names would be missing
#     and MC/LWJGL resolution would fall through the dependency closure to
#     the raw ANGLE frameworks (two GL id-namespaces, one context -- the
#     exact vgpu "material corruption" disease root-caused in Task204).
#
# Driven by the Makefile dep_nggl4es target (after dep_mg). Output
# libnggl4es.dylib is copied to $(WORKINGDIR) and rides the payload
# "cp $(WORKINGDIR)/*.dylib" into the app Frameworks, like vgpu/ltw.
# ============================================================================
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)
project(nggl4es)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# --- cache inputs filled in by the Makefile dep_nggl4es target ------------
set(NGGL4ES_GLSLANG_INCLUDE "" CACHE PATH "pinned glslang source dir (headers must match the static libs)")
set(NGGL4ES_GLSLANG_LIBS "" CACHE STRING "semicolon list of glslang/spirv static archives from the dep_mg build tree")
set(NGGL4ES_SPVC_IMPL "" CACHE FILEPATH "prebuilt libspirv-cross-c-shared.0.impl.dylib (C API)")
set(NGGL4ES_FRAMEWORK_DIR "" CACHE PATH "Amethyst resources/Frameworks (bundled ANGLE libEGL + libGLESv2)")
if(NOT NGGL4ES_GLSLANG_INCLUDE OR NOT NGGL4ES_GLSLANG_LIBS OR NOT NGGL4ES_SPVC_IMPL OR NOT NGGL4ES_FRAMEWORK_DIR)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "dep_nggl4es must pass NGGL4ES_GLSLANG_INCLUDE/NGGL4ES_GLSLANG_LIBS/NGGL4ES_SPVC_IMPL/NGGL4ES_FRAMEWORK_DIR (see Makefile)")
endif()

# Upstream flags kept; visibility hidden makes EXPORT / asm .global the only
# exported surface (house pattern, matches vgpu/ltw targets).
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS} -fPIC -fvisibility=hidden -DNO_GBM -DDEFAULT_ES=3 -DNOX11 -DNOEGL")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -fvisibility=hidden -DNO_GBM -DDEFAULT_ES=3 -DNOX11 -DNOEGL")

include_directories(
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include
    ${NGGL4ES_GLSLANG_INCLUDE}
)

# Source list = upstream C_SRC_FILES verbatim (including the NOT-ANDROID
# glx.c entry -- with NOX11 defined it compiles down to the handful of
# unconditional legacy stubs, same shape as the vgpu target) + the two
# upstream C++ entries + the Task206 generated darwin aliases.
set(NGGL4ES_SRC
    src/gl/string_utils.c
    src/gl/cJSON.c
    src/gl/config.c
    src/gl/arbconverter.c
    src/gl/arbgenerator.c
    src/gl/arbhelper.c
    src/gl/arbparser.c
    src/gl/array.c
    src/gl/blend.c
    src/gl/blit.c
    src/gl/buffers.c
    src/gl/build_info.c
    src/gl/debug.c
    src/gl/decompress.c
    src/gl/depth.c
    src/gl/directstate.c
    src/gl/drawing.c
    src/gl/enable.c
    src/gl/envvars.c
    src/gl/eval.c
    src/gl/face.c
    src/gl/fog.c
    src/gl/fpe.c
    src/gl/fpe_cache.c
    src/gl/fpe_shader.c
    src/gl/framebuffers.c
    src/gl/gl_lookup.c
    src/gl/gl4es.c
    src/gl/glstate.c
    src/gl/hint.c
    src/gl/init.c
    src/gl/light.c
    src/gl/line.c
    src/gl/list.c
    src/gl/listdraw.c
    src/gl/listrl.c
    src/gl/loader.c
    src/gl/logs.c
    src/gl/matrix.c
    src/gl/matvec.c
    src/gl/oldprogram.c
    src/gl/pixel.c
    src/gl/planes.c
    src/gl/pointsprite.c
    src/gl/preproc.c
    src/gl/program.c
    src/gl/queries.c
    src/gl/raster.c
    src/gl/render.c
    src/gl/shader.c
    src/gl/shaderconv.c
    src/gl/shader_hacks.c
    src/gl/stack.c
    src/gl/stencil.c
    src/gl/stubs.c
    src/gl/texenv.c
    src/gl/texgen.c
    src/gl/texture.c
    src/gl/texture_compressed.c
    src/gl/texture_params.c
    src/gl/texture_read.c
    src/gl/texture_3d.c
    src/gl/uniform.c
    src/gl/vertexattrib.c
    src/gl/wrap/gl4eswraps.c
    src/gl/wrap/gles.c
    src/gl/wrap/glstub.c
    src/gl/wrap/glesnative.cpp
    src/gl/math/matheval.c
    src/glx/hardext.c
    src/glx/lookup.c
    src/glx/gbm.c
    src/glx/streaming.c
    src/gl/vgpu/shaderconv.c
    src/gl/samplers.c
    src/glx/glx.c
    src/gl/glsl/glsl_for_es.cpp
    src/gl/getter.cpp
    # Task206: generated darwin aliases (bare gl* -> gl4es_gl*)
    src/gl/wrap/nggl4es_darwin_aliases.c
)

add_library(nggl4es SHARED ${NGGL4ES_SRC})

target_include_directories(nggl4es PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include
    ${NGGL4ES_GLSLANG_INCLUDE}
)

# glslang statics from the dep_mg tree + prebuilt SPIRV-Cross C API dylib.
target_link_libraries(nggl4es PRIVATE
    ${NGGL4ES_GLSLANG_LIBS}
    ${NGGL4ES_SPVC_IMPL}
    "-lc++"
)

# Bundled ANGLE frameworks (adaptation 2): linking them makes them
# LC_LOAD_DYLIB dependencies, so dlsym(renderer_handle, name) dependency-
# closure fallback for names the wrapper does NOT export resolves on the
# bundled ANGLE (correct backend for pure-ES names) instead of some random
# image -- the vgpu target uses the identical line.
target_link_libraries(nggl4es PRIVATE
    "-F${NGGL4ES_FRAMEWORK_DIR}"
    "-framework libEGL"
    "-framework libGLESv2"
)

set_target_properties(nggl4es PROPERTIES
    OUTPUT_NAME "nggl4es"
    MACOSX_RPATH ON
)
